## User story

**As an** analyst,
**I want** to enter a location in the dashboard,
**so that** I can analyse places beyond the existing city presets without sourcing an image.

## Acceptance criteria

**AC1 — Presets and global coordinates**
Given the location controls,
when I choose a city preset or enter coordinates,
then the presets supply their existing reference coordinates and latitude -90..90 and longitude -180..180 are accepted.

**AC2 — Coordinate-only request**
Given valid coordinates and no selected upload or preset image,
when I run the analysis,
then the dashboard submits the coordinate pair to the configured backend `/api/analyze` endpoint and displays the returned report.

**AC3 — Upload remains available**
Given a supported uploaded or seeded image,
when I choose the image input,
then I can still submit it for analysis through the existing upload path.

**AC4 — Show image provenance**
Given a report from either image source,
when the dashboard displays the result,
then it visibly distinguishes caller-uploaded imagery from imagery fetched by Google Maps.

## Tasks

- [ ] Add editable latitude and longitude inputs while retaining Singapore, Bangkok and Delhi as coordinate shortcuts.
- [ ] Let the analyst choose either a coordinate source or the existing upload/preset source.
- [ ] Send coordinate requests to the configured backend only; the dashboard must not call Maps directly.
- [ ] Render the returned `image_source` so analysts can tell uploaded imagery from Maps imagery.
- [ ] Add mocked-HTTP dashboard tests for both input modes, the selected coordinates and provenance display.

## Current state

The Streamlit dashboard has Singapore, Bangkok and Delhi reference coordinates, but they are display context only. Analysis currently requires a selected preset or upload, and there are no editable coordinate controls or image-source labels. The dashboard already sends analysis requests to the configured backend and must remain a presentation layer.

## Test cases

| Test                                                    | Asserts                                                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `test_dashboard_location_presets_and_coordinate_bounds` | City presets remain available and free coordinate inputs enforce the API's inclusive ranges |
| `test_dashboard_submits_coordinate_without_image`       | Coordinate-only action posts the selected `lat` and `lng` to the backend endpoint           |
| `test_dashboard_keeps_upload_analysis_available`        | A selected preset or upload still submits the image using the existing request path         |
| `test_dashboard_displays_image_source_provenance`       | Results distinguish caller-uploaded images from Google Maps imagery                         |

## Definition of done

All four cases pass with mocked HTTP, analysts can submit coordinates without an image, the upload workflow remains usable, and the dashboard renders returned image provenance without calling Maps or calculating analysis values itself.
